scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,edge-sim -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run start:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:edge-sim"
scripts.dev:frontend: sh -c 'api_host="${API_HOST:-http://localhost:8080}"; export VITE_API_BASE_URL="${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-$api_host}"; export OPENAPI_URL="${OPENAPI_URL:-$api_host/v3/api-docs}"; cd frontend && npm run dev'
scripts.build:frontend: sh -c 'api_host="${API_HOST:-http://localhost:8080}"; export VITE_API_BASE_URL="${VITE_API_BASE_URL:-$api_host}"; export OPENAPI_URL="${OPENAPI_URL:-$api_host/v3/api-docs}"; cd frontend && npm run build'
